sentences.text: Fukuisaurus was a relatively small ornithopod dinosaur.
This bipedal animal could also move on four legs, sharing a build similar to Iguanodon, Ouranosaurus, and Altirhinus.
In 2010, Gregory S. Paul estimated the creature to be 4.5 meters long and weigh 400 kg.
Remains were discovered in 1989 in Katsuyama, Fukui Prefecture, within rocks from the Barremian-aged Kitadani Formation.
The type species Fukuisaurus tetoriensis was described in 2003 by Yoshitsugu Kobayashi and Yoichi Azuma.
According to its describers, the skull lacked kinetic movement because the maxilla was fused to the vomer, making sideways chewing impossible.
The describers assigned Fukuisaurus to Iguanodontia, but noted features suggesting it also belongs to Styracosterna.
Fukuisaurus lived during the Aptian stage, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
There is a debate regarding Fukuisaurus's classification, with some studies placing it as a basal member of Hadrosauroidea and others recovering it as a non-hadrosauroid styracostern.
